title: Ginger chicken and broccoli stir-fry
summary: Thin chicken and broccoli stir-fried with ginger, garlic and tamari, served with a measured bowl of rice. A proper weeknight plate, not a takeaway portion.

steps.instruction: Slice the chicken and toss it with the cornflour, half the tamari and a pinch of salt. Put the broccoli in a heatproof bowl and cover it with just-boiled water for 2 minutes, then drain.
steps.tip: A quick blanch means the broccoli is tender before the chicken dries out.

steps.instruction: Cook the rice in 180 g of the water, covered, over a low heat. Start it before you heat the wok.
Heat the rapeseed oil in the wok until it smokes lightly. Stir-fry the chicken in one layer until it turns opaque, then scoop it out.
Add the ginger and garlic for a few seconds, then the carrot and broccoli. Splash in the remaining water and tamari and toss until the broccoli is bright and the sauce lightly coats everything.
Return the chicken, add the sesame oil and spring onion, and toss for a minute. Serve over the rice.
